---
title: "Examples"
---

Six complete workflows, each ported from a canonical, citable R original and
worked **backward from a realistic end model** — the model's requirements
decide which of the [four stages](../user-guide/basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd)
the recipe needs. Every report executes at build time; each example also links
a line-matched R ↔ Python side-by-side.

| Example | End model | Missing | Make numeric | Model prep | Multivar |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Ames mini](ames-mini-lm.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr01-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | lm | — | log\*, dummy | — | — |
| [Ames realistic](ames-realistic-lm.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr03-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | lm | — | log\*, other\*, dummy | interact\*, ns\* | — |
| [Ames xgboost](ames-xgboost.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr11-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | boosting | — | novel\*, one-hot, zv† | — | — |
| [Concrete KNN](concrete-knn.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr14-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | KNN | — | — | normalize | — |
| [Beans PCA](beans-pca.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/tmwr16-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | none | — | zv†, orderNorm\* | normalize | PCA |
| [Credit glmnet](credit-glmnet.qmd) · [R↔Py](sbs/kuhn-r-vs-py.html){target="_blank"} | logistic | impute ×2 | other\*, dummy, zv† | normalize | — |

\* not yet built in shoez — the reports run the buildable subset, and the
side-by-sides mark each gap in red where it occurs.
† zero-variance filter; filters sit beside the stages rather than in them,
shown here where they run.

## Running the examples locally

The reports execute with the `examples` extra:

```bash
uv sync --extra examples
uv run quarto render examples   # or: great-docs build
```

Datasets are vendored under `examples/data/` as parquet (exported from R's
[modeldata](https://modeldata.tidymodels.org/) package: `ames`, `concrete`,
`credit_data`, and the dry-beans data from Koklu & Ozkan via the
[beans](https://github.com/tidymodels/beans) package).
